Build receipt: t27 spec to XC7A200T bitstream, no Vivado

One real open-flow build itemised like a shop receipt: each stage from a t27 spec to an Artix-7 200T bitstream with its time, tool version, output size and sha256.

This page sets no cookie and sends nothing anywhere.

Where the numbers come from
  • scripts/widget-data/build-receipt.mjs run, 2026-10-04 on an Apple M1 Pro: every stage time (process.hrtime), cpu and peak memory (/usr/bin/time -l), output size and sha256 (node crypto), written to receipt.json
  • public/t27/t27_compiler.wasm in node, targets.verilog of specs/ternary/stream_ternary_mac.t27
  • Yosys 0.67+post b8e7da6f40: yosys -V; synth_xilinx -flatten -abc9 -arch xc7
  • nextpnr-xilinx 0.9.2-107-g7037c948 with ~/openxc7-src/chipdb/xc7a200tfbg676-1.bin: fmax and utilisation from its log, --freq 80 --seed 1
  • prjxray c9f02d85 fasm2frames.py and xc7frames2bit with prjxray-db ab1fc60 artix7 xc7a200tfbg676-1 part.yaml
  • bitwalk cross-check: gHashTag/t27 29b78e7fe specs/xilinx7, rust target of the same compiler, rustc 1.98.1
  • LED pins R23, T23, J26 LVCMOS33: gHashTag/t27 fpga/vsa/gf16_heartbeat_top.xdc (QMTech Wukong V1)
